HMPV Cases Detected in Karnataka

ICMR detects 2 cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Bengaluru during routine surveillance

1️⃣ A 3-month-old girl, treated for bronchopneumonia, has been discharged

2️⃣ An 8-month-old boy, tested positive on Jan 3, is recovering.
